description: This file defines extension methods for StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> to facilitate resuming stream consumption with various delegate handlers, providing flexible overloads for different callback scenarios.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> to resume stream consumption using delegates.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a stream with specified onNext, onError, and onCompleted handlers, returning a handle to manage the subscription. Multiple overloads support various combinations of handlers.
